mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.city, u.opt_lock_version, s.id as s_id, s.first_name as s_fn, s.last_name as s_ln, c.id as c_id, c.title as c_title, c.credits as c_credits, cs.id as cs_id FROM university u LEFT JOIN student s ON s.university_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.university_id = u.id LEFT JOIN student_course sc ON sc.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN student cs ON cs.id = sc.student_id WHERE u.id = #{id}

SELECT u.id, u.name, u.city, u.opt_lock_version, s.id as s_id, s.first_name as s_fn, s.last_name as s_ln, c.id as c_id, c.title as c_title, c.credits as c_credits, cs.id as cs_id FROM university u LEFT JOIN student s ON s.university_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.university_id = u.id LEFT JOIN student_course sc ON sc.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN student cs ON cs.id = sc.student_id ORDER BY u.id
